The '''Jal Shey belt''' was developed by the [[Jal Shey]] to help protect their minds from the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. This [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] group focused on the intellectual understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] rather than the physical aspects.
